QF.id: XVI Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_25

question.text: The overarching principles of the Code of Conduct for brokers dealing in commodity derivatives are:

answer.text: Maintain integrity, promptitude and fairness, act with due skill and care, avoid malpractices and conflicts, and protect the interests of clients
To maximize trading volume and revenue
To encourage clients to take more leveraged positions
To ensure the broker's profitability at all costs

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM Series XVI pages 191-193 and 203-204 set out the Code of Conduct in terms of integrity, promptitude and fairness, due skill and care, avoidance of acts detrimental to investors, disclosure and management of conflicts of interest, and protection of clients' interests. These are the source's overarching principles for brokers in commodity derivatives. The Trap: Maximising trading volume, encouraging more leverage, or putting broker profitability first all run counter to the Code's express obligations of fairness, due skill and protection of clients' interests. Note: The wording (integrity, promptitude, fairness, due skill and care, avoidance of malpractices, conflict management, protection of clients) is taken directly from the Code of Conduct provisions on pages 191-193 and 203-204.
